{{Top|leg}}
'''OO-7JB''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that lived in the droid community in [[X2-4]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a rift arose between the droids in the community and OO-7JB became allied with a non-violent loyalist droid faction. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to Uffel to investigate the problems there and [[HG-211]], the droid community's security chief, sent OO-7JB to escort the heroes to him.<ref name="Inside-out: Uffel's Prisoners">{{LivingForce|Inside-out: Uffel's Prisoners}}</ref>
